products.description_html:

The decor, which pays tribute to the majestic baobab trees, was designed by artists from Uniwax in Abidjan, with whom we have been working since the creation of our social and environmental partnership with the Cœur Vert Foundation.

The Bounkani fragrance diffuser becomes a decorative object in its own right and an essential piece in our collection. The design, in yellow on a gray background, is probably the most spring-like in this collection.


FRAGRANCE

The contrasting fragrance releases powerful, green notes of fig and hazelnut leaf, with an irresistibly seductive sandalwood base. Both an art object and an olfactory voyage, the Bounkani scented diffuser embodies the union of contemporary design and African cultural heritage, for a singular sensory experience.

USE
Indulge in the aromatic experience of your new home fragrance diffuser with these simple steps:

Start by unscrewing the cap of the diffuser. Remove the reeds from the packaging and uncork the plastic stopper. Place reeds through the opening of the acrylic top. Allow the reeds to soak in the fragrance for at least 48 hours after opening. To maintain the diffusion process, flip the reeds one or two times a week. This helps redistribute the fragrance and ensures a consistent scent in your space. Enjoy the delightful aroma!
